user_reported_bug: in the job dashboard. The map is covering the job information edit box as well as the transfer user page
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI testing shows the primary Leaflet stacking bug is fixed: New Job, Edit Job, Delete confirmation, Transfer Job dialog, and transfer user select rendered above the dashboard map with elementFromPoint proving dialog/select elements were topmost, and dashboard/job maps still rendered tiles, markers, and popups. However the bundled transferred-from feature is not fixed: after transfer, /api/jobs and /api/jobs/{id} responses omitted transferred_from, so the recipient card/detail header cannot show the amber note.

critical.issue: Transferred job responses omit transferred_from/transferred_at even after POST /api/jobs/{id}/transfer. Code review shows frontend expects these fields but backend Job response_model/model does not define them, so they are stripped from API responses.

integration_issues.issue: Recipient dashboard card and job detail header cannot display the new 'Transferred from {email}' note because API payloads do not include transferred_from.

action_items: Add transferred_from and transferred_at to backend models/job.py Job (and any relevant schemas) so GET /api/jobs and GET /api/jobs/{id} include them after transfer.
Retest transfer notice UI after the API exposes the fields. The map/dialog z-index fix itself passed focused verification.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css .leaflet-container { z-index: 0; isolation: isolate; } is present and runtime checks verified Leaflet panes no longer paint above Radix dialogs/select content.

backend/routes/jobs.py sets transferred_from/transferred_at on transfer, but models/job.py Job lacks those fields while routes use response_model=Job; Pydantic extra='ignore' prevents the frontend from receiving them.
seed_data_creation: Created throwaway admin-owned job 722a7d63-9fa7-4fc1-85da-62e831a844e5 with one GPS pole and recipient qa-transfer-1784736641@byers.com. Transferred job, then deleted the job via API and removed the test user from MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill lookup done before planning; no relevant testing skill found. The exact dashboard map overlay bug passed: screenshots were captured and programmatic elementFromPoint checks at multiple points inside Create/Edit/Delete/Transfer dialogs and the transfer select showed no Leaflet element above the content. Dashboard map and seed job map still loaded Esri tiles and markers; popups opened. Transfer ownership worked, but transferred_from was absent from API responses, causing the bundled notice feature to fail.
rca_of_the_issue: Primary RCA fixed: Leaflet panes used high z-index values without a constrained stacking context, and global .leaflet-container isolation/z-index now contains them under Radix z-50 dialogs. Remaining RCA: backend persists transferred_from in the transfer route, but response_model=Job strips unknown fields because Job does not declare transferred_from/transferred_at.
